📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-04-crm-amqp-consumer-monitor-family-quiet-period-flap`
This is occurrence #148 (147 prior; degraded-cycle catch-up after a ~13h overnight scheduler gap).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience` (`@customer-management` / `#team-customer-management`)
Playbook: Confirm shape (monitor in the 5-sibling family) → pull dd_search.py metric for the fired service → confirm 0 error logs → check sibling co-fire → escalate only if still open after ~1h or a sibling error/latency monitor co-fires.

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout`
This is occurrence #740 (degraded cycle — Slack MCP unavailable this session).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin` (`@admin` / `#team-admin`)
Playbook: 1) Confirm chronic baseline by comparing ES Ocelot.Responder.Middleware Warning volume vs the same window 24h ago — delta here is -94% (57 vs 948), well within chronic range. 2) Aggregate timeouts by RequestPath: dominant paths (10+ distinct accounts) are all /syncutil/syncwidget/{account}/GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync under upstream microservices.methodlocal.int — pool-level, not account-specific. 3) DNS/downstream-microservice root-cause steps not re-run this cycle (chronic, unchanged mechanism).
Open Jira: n/a — fix_status: chronic-residual-post-rollback-2026-06-05
